name: Message Size, BoxPlot by Source Category

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcecategory_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<sourcecategory>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/count as permessage
| min(permessage), pct(permessage,25), pct(permessage,50), pct(permessage,75), max(permessage), count by sourcecategory
